ablation.name: phase4i5b_sota_heun_cosine_5ep
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.5b: cosine + Heun + 5ep. 4I.5a (3ep) showed lpips=-0.0041 vs Heun-linear-3ep but clip -0.0004. Test if 5ep compounds the content gain (as Heun 5ep did vs 3ep). If clip recovers + lpips continues dropping, may surpass 4I.2b SOTA (clip=0.7266, lpips=0.3229).
